items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: And I actually got to meet him before he passed away. We were playing at McCoy Place in Chicago.

ctx.x: Wow. It sounds like you’re doing really good stuff. Our tape’s going to run out pretty soon. But I wanted to go back. You said the magic word to me early on. I’m a huge Cannonball fan, and always have been. And I wonder, why are you?

It was, I got the feeling of absolute joy when he played. It was life, it was joy, it was come on, let’s do it. And that’s what I tried to bring, rather than just slugging over patterns and things, I wanted to bring some kind of joy to what’s played. And I actually got to meet him before he passed away. We were playing at McCoy Place in Chicago. And I did the ugly fan thing.
